scripts.dev:seed: pnpm --filter functions build && concurrently -n emu,seed,app -c magenta,green,cyan "pnpm emulators" "node scripts/wait-and-seed.mjs" "pnpm --filter app dev"
scripts.spinup: pnpm --filter functions build && concurrently -n emu,seed -c magenta,green "pnpm emulators" "node scripts/wait-and-seed.mjs"
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:rules && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project productreinvention "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project productreinvention "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts"
